services.name: Safari Eco Sandbar Tour
services.desc: This Safari Eco tour is Key West’s best kept secret! Duration 2.5 hours About Jump in and captain your very own private boat as your tour guide takes you through Key West’s back country on this one of a kind Key West eco excursion. Travel through the mangrove islands, past Bird Key, into the Mud Keys on your way to the local treasure, Snipes Point sandbar for a dip in the beautiful turquoise waters. Grab some snorkel gear and explore this mangrove island, known for its crystal clear waters and abundant wildlife. Come explore our secluded beaches and mangrove islands only accessible by boat. This 25 mile guided tour is arguably the most beautiful Key West excursion. Included Guided
